name: Toujou Miku
source:
She is the protagonist's classmate and step sister of the same age. Friendly and good-natured, Miku is a popular person at the school.

She has a tendency that makes her want to take care of her brother, the protagonist. She has a history of failing whenever she tries to take care of him.

It seems that the protagonist always helps his sister. She is a bit of a klutz, but her natural brightness will make up for it!

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/kimikoi/chara.htm]official site[/url]]
